verification_level: FAST plus BATCH plus the affected X.509 policy differential, RT-STORE and phase-11 X.509 courts (including RT-X509-ACERT and RT-X509-REQ). Seven files audited, one deferred (ui_openssl.rs, a retained console callback/signal boundary), no source edit, no UB, no ABI regression and no hidden obligation.
scope: Per-file contract audit of the head entries of REMAINING-AUDIT.txt: the UI_METHOD legacy-callback wrapper, the X509_LOOKUP_store method, the policy-data constructor/destructor, the policy-tree accessors, the policy-node operations, and the attribute-certificate and CRL printers. src/ui/ui_openssl.rs was deferred NOT_RUN because it is a genuine console callback/signal I/O boundary.
not_discharged: All audited files are file-level audits, not SAFETY_DISCHARGED and not SAFE_COMPATIBLE.
src/ui/ui_openssl.rs was not audited (deferred console callback/signal boundary).
No Miri/ASan/Loom run was made: no owner, extent, aliasing or concurrency mechanism changed. No dudect/ctgrind claim is made.
FRF and the SEAL-level forensic regeneration were not run.
retained_obligations: src/ui/ui_util.rs: ui_read requires ui's method to be the wrapper built by UI_UTIL_wrap_read_pem_callback with its ex-data attached at the RUN_ONCE index; the userdata and callback remain caller-owned for the method's lifetime.

src/x509/by_store.rs: ctx is a live X509_LOOKUP whose method data is this method's own stack; a BorrowedStore's uri/propq are borrowed for the call and never released; the lookup's store is live and unlocked.
src/x509/pcy_lib.rs: tree.levels/tree.nlevel describe the live OwnedLevels block and no other borrow of that block is live for tree_levels' slice; level_ptr's tree is NULL or live.

src/x509/pcy_node.rs: the graph links a live datum to every node before it is observed; parent_mut's parent edge is NULL or live and not otherwise borrowed, and the graph keeps one Node per node (Node is Copy).
src/x509/pcy_data.rs: ossl_policy_data_free receives only a pointer ossl_policy_data_new returned and not yet freed.
src/x509/t_acert.rs and src/x509/t_crl.rs: bp/out is a live BIO and x is a live ACERT/CRL; every attribute/extension stack element is a live object of its tagged type.
residuals: M83-R1: ossl_policy_data_new allocates the 32-byte X509_POLICY_DATA with Box, so a caller-installed CRYPTO_set_mem_functions hook does not observe that block; the graph's own 24-byte node and 64-byte tree/levels blocks match in count and size, and ms_x509_policy_court.py adjudicates the divergence against measured container/ASN1-object controls (unadjudicated=0). Compatibility-only; recorded, not restructured.

M83-R2: the crate's X509_free still withholds ossl_policy_cache_free, so the per-cert policy cache's blocks are released by the authority and leaked by the crate. This is the freeze's recorded authoring gap, measured by the policy differential's cleanup window; not a new unsafe assumption and not repaired in this batch.

M83-R3: ui_read dereferences the method's ex-data without a NULL test, exactly as ui_util.c does; the wrapper always attaches non-NULL data, so the untested read is authority parity rather than a hidden precondition.

deferred.reason: console callback/signal I/O boundary (libc termios/sigaction, process signal table, static mut TTY_IN/TTY_OUT, blocking /dev/tty reads); retained in REMAINING-AUDIT.txt.

secret_bearing_buffers: No new secret-bearing buffer or cleansing claim changed. ui_util keeps the pem_password_cb_data callback pointer and rwflag (not a passphrase) and frees it plainly, as the authority's OPENSSL_free; UI_UTIL_read_pw_string cleanses its local BUFSIZ buffer on every path. The policy/ACERT/CRL units hold public certificate data only.
boundary_control: The policy differential's one-shot 24-byte allocation refusal proves ossl_policy_level_add_node propagates NULL and the check answers INTERNAL with a NULL tree on both sides.
The differential's bare OPENSSL_sk_* and OBJ_txt2obj controls measure the container/object invisibility that adjudicates M83-R1 rather than treating it as a graph divergence.
